android_mechanism: Every scanned port enqueues UI work without throttling; fix moves/throttles the work
bug_description: The search input's onChange handler fires a network search request to the backend for every single keystroke with no debounce or cancellation. Typing a 10-character query issues 10 requests, most of which are obsolete by the time they return; their responses race and each response re-assigns the result state, re-rendering the result list repeatedly and wasting radio/CPU and UI-thread time.
fix_summary: Search-as-you-type is debounced by 300ms (timer reset on each keystroke, cleared on submit), so one request is issued per paused query instead of one per keystroke.
trigger_steps: Ensure the device can reach the app's search backend.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, network, net).
Type a 10-character search keyword at normal speed, then submit.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Count of outbound HTTP search requests observed in the network trace while typing one 10-character query (plus submit).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed: ~11 requests per typed query (one per keystroke + submit); fixed: 1-2 requests. Corresponding CPU/radio activity and result-list re-renders drop proportionally.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 app sched network net -o /data/local/tmp/yt_debounce.chtrace
